review.reason: 리뷰 거절: internal/dlp/dlp.go:514-516 Reported() copies a Pod-controlled `Class` string verbatim into both Class and Label of the filed finding when the class is unknown (verified: Reported(Finding{Class:"900101-1234568"}) files {Class:900101-1234568 Label:900101-1234568}). The change closes the sample/label channel but opens/keeps an equally writable one in the same JSON blob that goes to audit_events and every CSV export; a finding of an unknown class should be dropped or filed under a fixed class name, not echoed. / docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md:174-176 states 'Pod 가 무엇을 보내든 트레일에 값이 실리지 않습니다' — false. `class`, `server`, `tool`, `direction` in internal/api/dlp.go:209-211 are still filed as sent with no validation or length bound; the doc (and the PDF rebuilt from it) over-promises a security property the code does not have. / internal/dlp/dlp.go:482-486,505-507 the comment/commit claim that re-masking 'changes nothing on a sample the scanner really produced' and that no genuine sample reaches 64 runes is false: the secret pattern `sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}` and the email pattern are unbounded. Verified: a genuine 83-rune sk- key sample is refiled at 64 runes (Reported(s) != s). TestAReportedFindingIsFiledAsTheScannerWouldHaveFiledIt only uses a 22-char key, so the stated invariant is not actually tested at the boundary.
